bullets: House ad copy now leads with the Freebuff tier name and describes allowances in hours instead of sessions.
A new single advertiser-branded row can appear in the CLI, above the input during PR-intent drafts and inside the /review menu.
An after-sign-in Discord invite banner now shows across CLI login and plain login surfaces with a clickable invite link.
Slash and mention menus now own Up and Down navigation in non-empty drafts instead of the composer swallowing those keys.
Freebuff session gate errors now explain when a run stopped mid-message and automatically admit a new session on the next send.
BYOK runs now resolve the real context window from the provider instead of compacting at the 32,768 default.
The web researcher helper now stops after 15 steps and forces a final answer instead of looping up to 200 steps.
The launcher now detects Bun AVX2 crashes via stderr on Windows exit code 3, not just illegal instruction codes.
The peak-window time zone resolver now falls back to UTC when a browser cannot format the reported zone, preventing crashes on the model picker.
The OpenRouter to Anthropic model ID mapping now handles dotted version ids like claude-opus-5.5 without 404ing.
